strings.onboarding.mic.denied: Microphone access is needed to record your voice. Tap Allow microphone to try again.
strings.onboarding.mic.blocked: Microphone access is off. Open Quill's app settings, choose Permissions, then allow Microphone. Return here to test it.
strings.settings.cleanup.automatic_help: Use the speech provider's active key with a known free cleanup option. Automatic cleanup stays off when no free option is known. Free-tier quotas apply. Choosing a separate provider or model below is a manual choice and may cost money.
strings.onboarding.splash.tagline: Speak, instead of typing, in any app. Quill is 100% free & 100% private.
strings.onboarding.welcome.title: Speak, instead of typing, in any app. For free.
strings.onboarding.welcome.body: A small bubble floats over the screen. Tap it & speak. Your words appear where your cursor is.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.free_tier: You bring the key - some providers (like Groq) have a free tier to start.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.usage: Your provider may charge for usage - Quill itself is free.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.reading: Take a moment to read this
strings.onboarding.howitworks.title: From voice to text, on your terms
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step1: The bubble starts listening - tap again to send.
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step2: Audio goes straight to your speech-to-text key. No middleman.
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step3: Text drops in at the cursor - chat, email, search, notes.
strings.onboarding.checklist.title: You're connected
strings.onboarding.key.title: Add your key
strings.onboarding.key.body: A key is a long private code from an AI service. It lets Quill send your voice to the AI & get text back over an encrypted connection. Never share your key with anyone.
strings.onboarding.key.where_link: Where do I get a key?
strings.onboarding.key.console_body: Any of these works - pick one for quick steps to get its key. Your key stays on this device.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.title: Get your %1$s key
strings.onboarding.key.guide.groq_steps:
Click https://console.groq.com/home to open browser
Create a Groq account
Click on API Keys near the top right
Click on "Create API Key"
Choose any name you like. For example "Quill".
Keep No Expiration.
Click the Copy button
Come back to Quill. Paste the copied key below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.openai_steps:
1. Sign in at platform.openai.com.
2. Open API keys and tap Create new secret key.
3. Copy the key right away - it's shown only once - then paste it into Quill.
4. New accounts usually need a small billing credit before the key will transcribe.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.openrouter_steps:
Click https://openrouter.ai/sign-up to open browser
Sign up for OpenRouter.
Choose Individual.
Click Copy button (two overlapping sheets)
Come back to Quill. Paste the copied key below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.gemini_steps:
Click https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys to open browser
[For New Users] Accept Agreement & Click Continue
Click the Copy button (two overlapping sheets)
Come back to Quill. Paste the copied key below.
strings.stt.quota.toast: API usage has run out - check your provider plan.
strings.key.error.invalid: That key was rejected (401). Check you copied it fully.
strings.key.error.network: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.
strings.onboarding.mic.title: Allow the microphone
strings.onboarding.mictest.title: Say something
strings.onboarding.mictest.body: Let's check your mic. Speak now - you should see the strokes move.
strings.onboarding.overlay.title: Allow the floating bubble
strings.onboarding.allset.title: You're ready to write
strings.onboarding.allset.body: The bubble is live. Open any app, focus a text field, and give it a try.
strings.onboarding.allset.look: Look for this in the corner of your screen.
strings.history.title: History
strings.history.empty.on_body: Your dictation transcripts show up here. Saved on this phone only.
strings.history.empty.off_body: Turn on Save dictation history in Settings to keep transcripts on this phone.
strings.history.clear.title: Delete all history?
strings.history.clear.body: This removes all %1$d saved dictations from this device. It can't be undone.
strings.home.banner.a11y_off_text: Accessibility is off - tap to switch it back on.
strings.home.today.last_used_sub: Not yet - tap the bubble to dictate in any app.
strings.home.tip.title: Touch the bubble to move and drop anywhere.
strings.home.tip.text: Long-press to dictate to the clipboard
strings.home.paused.banner_title: Turn Quill on to bring back the bubble.
strings.home.paused.banner_text: The bubble is hidden. Quill stays ready so you can bring it back anytime.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.speech.title: Speech & model
strings.settings.speech.language_help: English keeps mixed Hindi-English speech in Roman script ("aaj ka"). Auto-detect or Hindi give native script.
strings.settings.speech.gemini_caveat: Gemini is a chat model asked to transcribe - spoken commands may occasionally be paraphrased instead of written word-for-word.
strings.settings.speech.key_required: No API key saved for %1$s yet. Add one to dictate with this provider.
strings.settings.speech.model_field_hint: Exact model ID from your provider
strings.settings.speech.custom_url_help: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Quill calls <base URL>/audio/transcriptions with your key.
strings.settings.keys.title: API keys
strings.settings.keys.empty_body: Quill needs a speech-to-text key to transcribe. Add one to start dictating again.
strings.settings.keys.banner: Keys are encrypted in this device's keystore and never leave it or appear in logs.
strings.settings.keys.help: Your cleanup model reuses this key unless you add a separate one.
strings.settings.cleanup.title: Clean up with AI
strings.settings.cleanup.provider_help: Cleanup uses the selected provider and its saved key. All three writing styles apply here. If cleanup fails or takes too long, Quill keeps your original transcript.
strings.settings.cleanup.custom_endpoint: Custom cleanup shares the custom endpoint and key with transcription. Saving a different URL changes both.
strings.settings.cleanup.groq_key: Cleanup always runs on Groq - it uses your saved Groq key, not your active provider's.
strings.settings.cleanup.groq_missing: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key it's skipped and the raw transcript is inserted.
strings.settings.style.title: Writing style
strings.settings.style.intro: Match how you write in each app - more formal at work, more relaxed with friends.
strings.settings.style.formal_sub: Full sentences, always punctuated, no contractions
strings.settings.style.neutral_sub: Sentence case, standard punctuation, as you said it
strings.settings.style.needs_cleanup: Writing style rides on the AI cleanup pass - turn on "Clean up with AI" for it to apply.
strings.settings.style.needs_groq: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key, writing style won't be applied.
strings.settings.style.words_promise: Style only changes punctuation, capitalization and contractions. It never changes your words.
strings.settings.style.help: Style is picked from the app you were in when you started speaking. Custom words are still applied last.
strings.settings.words.title: Custom words
strings.settings.words.body: Teach Quill names and terms it keeps mishearing. Each is matched and replaced after transcription.
strings.settings.words.empty_sub: Tap + to add a name or term
strings.settings.words.err_key: Add an API key in Settings to use voice capture.
strings.settings.words.err_permission: Microphone access is needed to record.
strings.settings.vocab.title: Contacts vocabulary
strings.settings.vocab.body: Import names from your contacts so Quill can learn how the people you know are spelled. Names are stored only on this device and are never sent anywhere.
strings.settings.vocab.import_failed: Couldn't read contacts. The previous import was kept.
strings.settings.vocab.empty_sub: Import from contacts to see them here
strings.settings.vocab.permission_needed: Contacts access is needed to import names. You can grant it in system settings.
strings.settings.vocab.clear_confirm_body: This removes every imported contact name from this device. Your custom words are not affected.
strings.settings.audio.title: Audio & recording
strings.settings.audio.silence_banner: In very noisy places this may not trigger - the max-length limit always applies.
strings.settings.privacy.title: Privacy and History
strings.settings.privacy.banner_text: Audio goes only to your provider; everything else stays on this phone.
strings.settings.privacy.history_sub: Kept on this phone, then auto-deleted
strings.settings.privacy.crash_sub: Only if a crash happens - you review first
strings.settings.privacy.diag_help: Reports include the error, app version and device - never your audio, text, clipboard, or key.
strings.settings.bubble.title: Visual preferences
strings.settings.bubble.help: The light ring keeps the bubble visible on any background.
strings.settings.advanced.title: Advanced
strings.settings.advanced.endpoint_help: For any OpenAI-compatible provider. Changing this re-validates your key.
strings.settings.advanced.keepalive_sub: Helps on phones that kill apps
strings.settings.advanced.battery_sub: Open battery settings → find Quill → allow unrestricted
strings.settings.advanced.clear_confirm_body: This removes your saved key, clears your dictation history and custom words, and resets every setting on this device. It can't be undone.
strings.settings.advanced.reset_confirm_body: Restores all preferences to their defaults. Your API key and dictation history are kept.
strings.settings.about.title: About
strings.settings.about.footer: Made for the speakers, not the typers.
strings.system.recovery.title: Quill stopped typing into apps
strings.system.recovery.banner_text: Your phone switched off Accessibility access - Quill can't insert text until it's back on.
strings.system.recovery.heading: Let's switch it back on
strings.system.recovery.body: Some phones turn this off to save battery. Turning it back on takes two taps.
strings.system.crash.title: Send crash report?
strings.system.crash.body: Quill closed unexpectedly last time. You can send a report to help fix it - here's exactly what it contains:
strings.system.crash.banner: Sent through your own share sheet - you choose the app, nothing auto-uploads.
strings.reliability.boot.title: Tap to re-activate Quill
strings.reliability.boot.text: Your phone restarted. Open Quill to bring the bubble back.
strings.inject.failed.title: Copied to clipboard
strings.inject.failed.text: Couldn't insert here - paste your dictation manually.
strings.inject.revoked.title: Quill was turned off - copied instead
strings.inject.revoked.text: Accessibility is off, so Quill couldn't insert. Re-enable it, then paste.
strings.home.battery.title: Quill keeps getting stopped
strings.home.battery.text: Open battery settings, find Quill, and set it to Unrestricted so it stops getting killed.
strings.settings.survival.title: Help Quill survive
strings.settings.survival.body: Some phones (Honor, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung) aggressively stop background apps. To keep the bubble alive, allow Quill to auto-start / run in the background in your device's app-management settings.
strings.settings.survival.steps:
1. Open your device's app-launch or protected-apps settings.
2. Find Quill in the list.
3. Allow auto-start / background activity (and set battery to Unrestricted).
strings.settings.survival.fallback: Couldn't open it automatically on this device - open Settings ▸ Battery / App management and find Quill manually.
strings.notification.text.hidden: Bubble hidden - tap Show Quill to bring it back.
strings.notification.text.recording: Recording… tap the bubble to stop.
strings.bubble.dismiss.toast: Bubble hidden - shake your phone or tap the notification to bring it back.
strings.bubble.bin.label: Drag here to hide
strings.bubble.autoreturn.toast: Quill's back. Drag the bubble to the bin to hide it again.
strings.compliance.rationale.mic: Quill needs the microphone to record what you dictate. Audio is sent only to the speech provider whose key you supply, and is deleted after a successful transcription.
strings.compliance.rationale.overlay: The floating bubble needs permission to display over other apps. That bubble is also what lets Quill record while you're in another app.
strings.compliance.rationale.accessibility: Quill uses accessibility only to detect the focused text field and insert your dictation. It never reads or writes password or banking fields.
strings.compliance.privacy.promise: Quill has no account and runs no server. Your audio and transcripts stay on this device except for the direct, encrypted call to the provider you chose.
strings.compliance.key.required_title: You'll need your own API key
strings.compliance.key.required_body: Quill is bring-your-own-key: it transcribes using your own provider account (e.g. Groq or OpenAI). Without a key, Quill can't transcribe. Your key is encrypted on this device and never sent to us.
strings.compliance.privacy.welcome_pill: Your key, your audio - nothing through our servers
strings.models.fallback: Could not refresh. Showing saved or built-in choices.
strings.models.ranking: Free compatible models appear first, followed by dictation or cleanup candidates. Free-tier quotas apply; check your provider plan. Preview models can change or disappear.
strings.models.custom_refresh: Tap Refresh to check this endpoint’s model list.
strings.onboarding.key.easy: Google Gemini (Big Free Usage, Easy Process)
strings.onboarding.key.free_note: Free-tier limits apply. Paid accounts may be billed under their plan. Quill checks your key without sending audio; successful dictation also depends on your model access and available quota.
strings.onboarding.key.router_note: Free cleanup models are available. Speech transcription may require credits. Quill prefers a free compatible speech model when the live catalog offers one. Checking your key does not spend model credits.
strings.onboarding.key.format_help: Enter a complete key starting with %1$s.
strings.onboarding.key.unverified: We could not reach the provider to check this key. Your draft is kept securely. Check your connection, then try again.
strings.onboarding.key.storage_error: We could not save your key securely. Keep this screen open and try again.
strings.onboarding.key.read_steps: I have read the steps. I will return to Quill to paste my key.
strings.onboarding.key.browser_error: The browser could not open. Try again after choosing a default browser in Android settings.
